targets_rule: arm.target_grid: x0 + 5 cm to the reach of mu = 0.49 (the highest in the set) at 90% of the cap

arm.peak_cap_rule: arm.limited_peak_speed within v/tau/a limits, floored to the mm/s
arm.practice_rule: decide.practice_speed: on the board for the generic prior's 5% quantile, at most the cap

noise: nominal (2 mm frames, 0.5 mm rest and release points)
